svg.title: ARC-301 Section B–B — Transverse
svg.text: Masonry wall cut by section — 200 mm
Internal stud or block partition, 120 mm
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab
1. Cut at y = 10.80, inside the stair well and clear of every
cross wall, looking north. A-A cuts the other way and
shows the depth; this is the only drawing of the width.
2. What the cut passes through was read off the plans by the
probe in checks.py, not written from memory, and whether
the east wall is glazed at the cut is worked out from the
plan's own opening list each time the sheet is built.
3. The east wall is glazed on the lower three floors and
solid on the third, which is the plans' arrangement and
not a drafting choice. It can be glazed at all because the
neighbour a metre east is a single storey.
4. The stair is beyond the cut, not in it: its flights run
north-south, so this section crosses them end-on and they
are drawn in thin line as seen through the open well.
5. At the penthouse the west half of the plate is the open
corridor, outside the flat and open to the sky under its
pergola. Foundations are indicative pending GEO-001.
Preliminary design issue — not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
P16 2026-10-07 neighbours as surveyed: west 3 storeys and blind, east single storey
P17 2026-10-07 ARC-000 deliverables list; title corrected to five storeys
P18 2026-10-07 scheme A adopted: serpentine balcony on every plan; site named
P19 2026-10-07 serpentine waist deepened 0.75 to 1.35 m; 15.7 m² of balcony a floor
